about: What layer 1 of the mockup fidelity gate (test/ui-tokens.test.js) does not hold yet. tokens: a token of app/renderer/tokens.css whose value the app uses today and the mockup's shared rules (app/renderer/ui) contradict; the mockup's value is the target. fonts: a face the mockup's rules ask for that is not bundled (none since m5-ui-alignment-chrome). literals: colour and size literals per file that should name a token. The test fails on anything beyond this ledger and on an entry that no longer applies, so it only shrinks; the feature named in gate ends with it empty. Decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-15: every literal becomes a token and there is no allowlist; the mockup's token values win; JetBrains Mono Medium is bundled. m5-ui-tokens-spacing cleared the token entries (the mockup's --ruler-h, --zone-tabs, --meter-w and --focus are the tokens' values) and the literals of app/renderer/ui and of mockup.html; m5-ui-alignment-chrome cleared the font entry (JetBrains Mono Medium is bundled) and the literals of the rules it replaced with the shared stylesheets, and the component port features (m5-ui-port-*, decided by the maintainer, 2026-11-17) clear the rest.
